description: Na₂Tl₂B₁₀O₁₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.85 Å. Tl is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one O atom. The Tl-O bond length is 2.80 Å. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.50 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.50 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond length. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond length. In the fifth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Tl and two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two B atoms.
